Hi Jonas,

We’re getting ready for our vendor security review for an upcoming procurement cycle and need Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge letter if the latest Type II is not yet available). A few logistics/questions:
- Preferred secure transfer method for the report (SFTP, secure Drive link, DocuSign, etc.)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: procurement@novara.com
Date: 2025-05-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and audit period clarification

Hi Lisa — thanks for the note and the timeline. Happy to help. Quick answers up front:

- Audit period: Our latest SOC 2 Type II covers 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31.
- Bridge letter: Yes — we can provide a signed bridge letter that covers the period after the report through the present. We typically issue these for procurement requests when the most recent report predates a customer’s deadline.
- Transfer methods: We support secure SFTP upload, a time-limited secure Drive link, or DocuSign for signed documents. SFTP is usually fastest for larger bundles.

What I’ve attached to this email: redwood-soc2-intake-checklist.pdf (what we typically include), sftp-upload-instructions.txt (SFTP endpoint + brief steps), and bridge-letter-examples.docx (sample language we can adapt). If you prefer Drive/DocuSign, we can send a link early tomorrow.

Minimum deliverables we commonly share:
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) or bridge letter (PDF)
- Attestation letter or management representation statement, if requested
- If needed, a short cover note stating scope and any system exclusions

On redaction: we allow customer-identifying data to be redacted on request (we redact tenant names/IDs when needed) but prefer minimal redaction to preserve context. Let us know any specific fields you require redacted and we’ll call out the changes in the cover note.

If that works, I’ll loop in our security team and CS to prepare the package for SFTP transfer. Do you want us to plan for delivery by May 22nd if you can accept SFTP?

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
